But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial   AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.  That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.
